panels.description: BPC_ASD_CH2 の実測電圧。他の機器と独立した縦軸。取得できていない期間はデータなし。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  "timestamp" AS "time",
  vmon AS "voltage"
FROM public.e80_kikusui
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
  AND module_name = 'BPC_ASD_CH2'
ORDER BY "timestamp" ASC;

panels.title: E50_discriminator / current

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  module_name,
  "timestamp",
  v0set,
  vmon,
  i0set,
  imon,
  ip_address,
  pw
FROM (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY module_name ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC) AS rn
  FROM e80_kikusui
  WHERE module_name IN (
    'BPC_ASD_CH2', 'BPC_ASD_CH3', 'BPC_ASD_CH4',
    'BPM_bias', 'polarimeter_bias', 'TOF_bias',
    'trigger_bias', 'AC_bias', 'E50_discriminator'
  )
) t
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY module_name;
